## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Restore rejection of empty requirement criteria before merge: the refactor changes `requirement_proven([])` from `False` to `True`, incorrectly treating an unsupported requirement as proven.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Calling `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True`. The empty-input branch only logs a warning, after which `sum(...)` and `len(criteria)` both equal zero; the previous `bool(criteria)` guard rejected this case. Return `False` immediately after the warning and add an empty-list regression test, since the existing proof tests exercise only nonempty lists. — Release review can classify a requirement with no criteria as proven.
